method: R1 blind suread (subagent read text only, no md/rules)

facts.fact: Hattie 在彻底昏倒前撑住自己，抓住厨房台面站稳。
facts.anchor: Hattie catches herself in mid-faint before she can fully collapse.

facts.fact: Tommy 站在厨房中央摊开双手，后退一步。
facts.anchor: Tommy stands in the middle of the kitchen, palms up.

facts.fact: Hattie 示意到餐桌坐下，并打开厨房水槽上方的一盏灯。
facts.anchor: He shuffles to a chair and she sits opposite him after turning on a single light over the kitchen sink.

facts.fact: Hattie 说她是从那通 911 电话认出他的，并感谢他救了 Sloan。
facts.anchor: The 911 call. Nothing else made sense.

facts.fact: Tommy 说他一直做心肺复苏直到听见汽车开来。
facts.anchor: I did CPR until I heard a car pull up. It was all I could think to do.

facts.fact: Tommy 说他从五月起就一直在这里，藏在阁楼。
Tommy 交代靠 Leah 的父母找到教会地下室的领养档案，半夜取走 Leah 的文件。
facts.anchor: Waited until the middle of the night and found Leah’s file. Then walked out the next day after they reopened.

facts.fact: Tommy 说本想走进海里让水流带走自己，但见到 Sloan 后做不到。
facts.anchor: I was going to walk into the ocean. Let the current carry me away. But after I saw him, I couldn’t get myself to.

facts.fact: Tommy 说他喜欢 Sloan，会听他的生活，Sloan 没人时会唱歌。
facts.anchor: He sings when no one’s here.

facts.fact: Hattie 伸手握住他的手，说“我们回家吧”。
